scope: Actual finite-point local DVRs and full function-field embeddings, exact normalized chord/tangent/vertical orders and corresponding actual point divisors for every field and general Weierstrass model. Actual evaluation kernel is the actual coordinate point ideal, maximal/surjective. Shifted actual curve equation and one nonzero partial derivative derive a nonzero principal maximal ideal and actual local DVR; no regularity/DVR premise. Explicit injective localization map and full actual FunctionField fraction-ring equality proved. Official normalized height-one adic valuation of this actual local ring gives exact order from actual principal ideal powers. Existing actual chord/negative-point principal ideal identities localize: equal-point ideal maps to maximal, different-point ideal to unit ideal, so all finite multiplicities count repeated intersection points. Combine actual infinity-chart pole orders -3/-2 to prove finite support and actual Finsupp principal point divisors line=(P)+(Q)+(-P-Q)-3(O), vertical=(P)+(-P)-2(O), and actual three-torsion tangent=3(P)-3(O). Actual F5 y²=x³+1 controls: X-xP not a local uniformizer at two-torsion(4,0), ordinary tangent at(2,2) has order2 there and another simple zero at(0,1), so deleting three-torsion makes the actual tangent divisor assertion false. The point-divisor is defined from actual normalized local valuations, not an arbitrary postulated multiplicity function. Over arbitraryK it is on actual nonsingular K-points; for an elliptic curve over algebraically closedK these are all geometric points. Separate Mathlib projective Scheme.localRing/Divisor interoperability, general all-function divisor finiteness, translation/Weil reciprocity/isogeny/Lang/Cartier/Jacobian/canonical Weil-Tate/MOV-FR/all14 remain open. Twenty-seven modules include nineteen exact credited earlier modules and eight new modules. Same host/prover/Mathlib; full-header audit procedural only, no independent compiler/parser/physicalhost assurance. Qualified source statements survive; no novelty/canonical promotion/signed-standing claim.
